title: 4BSD routing diagnostic tool available for ftp (Van Jacobson traceroute announcement reproduction)

date.notes: Date and headers preserved in a later reproduction; original mailing-list archive should still be recovered.

claims_extracted.claim: The reproduced December 20, 1988 message announces a 4BSD routing diagnostic tool called traceroute, sending multiple probes per TTL and reporting responding gateways and round-trip times.
claims_extracted.notes: Primary-message content preserved in secondary hosting; original list archive should replace this as canonical evidence.

claims_extracted.claim: The announcement says the then-current tool required a small 4BSD kernel change to permit user control of IP TTL on raw output.

notes: Discovery/bridge source; do not treat the GitHub gist itself as the historical origin.
